SELECT 
    u.user_id,
    u.full_name,
    u.line_uid,
    COUNT(t.transaction_id) as total_jobs,
    SUM(t.actual_price) as total_revenue,
    SUM(t.commission_amount) as total_commission
FROM users u
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE t.payout_status = 'unsettled' AND t.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.full_name, u.line_uid;

INSERT INTO payouts (user_id, start_date, end_date, total_jobs, total_revenue, commission_total, net_payout, payout_status)
VALUES (
  {{ $('Admin API Gateway').item.json.body.user_id }},
  NOW(), NOW(),
  {{ $('Admin API Gateway').item.json.body.total_jobs }},
  {{ $('Admin API Gateway').item.json.body.total_revenue }},
  {{ $('Admin API Gateway').item.json.body.total_commission }},
  {{ $('Admin API Gateway').item.json.body.total_commission }},
  'paid'
);

SELECT 
    t.transaction_id,
    u.full_name AS barber_name,
    s.service_name,
    t.payment_method,
    t.actual_price,
    t.commission_amount,
    t.status,
    t.payout_status,
    u.line_uid AS barber_line_uid,
    t.created_at
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN services s ON t.service_id = s.service_id
ORDER BY t.transaction_id DESC
LIMIT 100;
